# Site survey & positioning data contract (v0)

Shared by the survey tool (`indoor-nav/survey`), the map builders (`mapdata/tools/build_*.py`) and the on-device
positioning engine (`indoor-nav/src/positioning`). Coordinates are local metres (see SCHEMA.md). Time is epoch ms.

## 1. Survey plan — `data/tianmu/survey/<level>_plan.geojson` (generated by `tools/survey_plan.py`)
- `Point`, props `{kind: "point", id: "1F-sp001", level, near}` — WiFi point-survey locations (~4 m apart along accessible corridors).
- `LineString`, props `{kind: "walk", id: "1F-walk-north", level, name, length_m}` — straight corridor runs for the magnetic walk survey. Walk them end to end at a steady pace, in **both directions** (separate recordings).

## 2. Survey session — uploaded JSON, stored as `mapdata/survey/raw/<session_id>.json`
```jsonc
{
  "schema": "tpnav-survey/0",
  "session_id": "20261107-142530-a71",        // unique; also the file name
  "venue": "tianmu",
  "device": { "model": "SM-A716B", "platform": "android", "user_agent": "..." },
  "started_at": 1794030000000,
  "wifi_points": [
    {
      "point_id": "1F-sp012",                  // from the plan, or null for an ad-hoc point
      "level": "1F", "x": 11.0, "y": 31.2,       // where the surveyor stood
      "scans": [                                  // one entry per fresh scan (scan_started true, new results)
        { "collected_at": 1794030012345, "results": [ { "bssid": "aa:bb:..", "ssid": "..", "level": -61, "frequency": 2437, "timestamp": 165349089732 } ] }
      ]
    }
  ],
  "walks": [
    {
      "walk_id": "1F-walk-north", "level": "1F",
      "direction": "forward" | "reverse",         // reverse = walked from the LineString's last vertex to its first
      "path": [[14.6, 65.6], [73.7, 65.0]],       // vertices in walking order
      "t_start": 1794030100000, "t_end": 1794030160000,
      "marks": [ { "t": 1794030130000, "vertex": 3 } ],   // optional: surveyor tapped when passing a path vertex
      "phone_pose": "flat" | "upright",           // how the phone was held (flat = screen up, top pointing forward)
      "sensors": {                                 // raw batches concatenated, same tuples as the sensor_stream bridge
        "accelerometer": [[t, x, y, z], ...],
        "gyroscope": [[t, x, y, z], ...],
        "magnetometer": [[t, x, y, z], ...],      // µT, device frame
        "barometer": [[t, hPa], ...]              // optional: absent in older walks and on phones without one
      },
      "wifi_scans": [ { "collected_at": 1794030120000, "results": [ ... ] } ]  // scans that completed during the walk
    }
  ]
}
```
Walk positions are reconstructed by linear interpolation along `path` by arc length between `t_start` / marks / `t_end`
(constant speed assumption between consecutive marks).

## 3. Built maps — `data/tianmu/positioning/`
- `wifi_radiomap.json` — per fingerprint location: `{ id, level, x, y, n_scans, aps: { "<bssid>": { mean, std, detect } } }`
  plus global `{ bssids: [...], built_at, sessions: [...] }`. `detect` = fraction of scans in which the AP was seen.
- `magmap_<level>.json` — magnetic map along walkable corridors: grid cells (default 0.5 m) with
  `{ x, y, B: |B| µT, Bv: vertical component µT, Bh: horizontal magnitude µT, n }` (orientation-invariant features:
  vertical = projection on the gravity unit vector from the accelerometer, Bh = sqrt(B² − Bv²)), plus a per-device
  offset note. Cells with no data are omitted; consumers interpolate along the corridor.

## 4. Positioning engine output (in-app)
`{ t, level, x, y, accuracy_m, heading_deg | null, source: "wifi" | "pdr" | "fused", confidence: 0..1 }`
